_scoring.scope_note: counts include the 2 calibration laws (13 laws audited); 7 of the 11 sample laws have no stored record, 3 of them (A7152, A8154, A3021) with no blind item either, A7281 dropped by designation_no_actor and not on the blind list

_classes.name: Second earlier-chapter sunset/revival sentence in the same law not stored (only one extension record kept when the law amends two chapters' expiry clauses)
_classes.rule: packet heuristic: per law, count act sections that amend 'section N of chapter M of the laws of YYYY' to read as follows (reprinted body merged) and contain a braced year plus /expire|deemed repealed|full force and effect|shall be repealed/; flag the law when that count is >=2 and exceeds the number of stored records with extends_existing true and that regex in quote (over-counts omnibus laws such as 2013-S2605, so each hit needs a look)

_classes.name: Sunset-extension records split between kind duty and kind power for the same kind of provision (DOS ticket-resale extensions stored as duty; Oct 19 rule stores unnamed-holder extensions as power)
_classes.rule: extends_existing == true and re.search(r'(expire|deemed repealed|full force and effect|shall be repealed)', quote, re.I) and kind == 'duty' (85 duty vs 312 power)
